description:
Subject: Artist Profile – The Velvet Echoes (ID: artist_001)

The Velvet Echoes is an indie rock band celebrated for its atmospheric soundscapes and lyrical depth. Their catalogue includes two standout tracks: “Silent Horizon,” which runs 215 seconds, and “Midnight Pulse,” clocking in at 189 seconds. Looking ahead, the group’s upcoming engagements feature the Autumn Festival on 2023‑09‑15 at the Riverfront Amphitheatre, followed by the Spring Tour Kickoff on 2024‑03‑02, to be held at City Hall Plaza.
